Accept.description:
A finding the map's maker accepts: its kind and message as `map.check`
gives them, and why the map keeps it.

message.description: The finding's message, word for word.

reason.description: Why the map keeps what the finding names.

Anchor.description:
What a note belongs to: an item, with the note's start offset from the
item's centre, or a line, with a point along it and an offset across it.

item.description: The item, and the note's start offset from its centre.

line.description: The line, and the note's point along it and offset across it.

At.description: An item's stored centre and who set it.

set.description:
engine when placement chose the position, which a later run with
relayout may move, and pinned when a person or agent set it, which
placement never moves.

numeric.description:
Whether the column's cells are numbers, drawn right aligned; false
when left out.

Item.description:
One thing the map shows, drawn as a round mark with a label of one or
more lines beside it.

at.description: The mark's stored centre; left out until it is placed.

bin.description:
Which of the ramp's bins shades the mark, counted from 0 for the
first; the mark is unshaded when left out.

column.description:
The item's place in its lane's left to right order. Placement keeps
an item with a lower column left of one with a higher column in the
same lane; items sharing a column are not ordered.

id.description:
The item's name, unique among the map's items, which lines and notes
name.

label.description:
The label's lines, first the name and then any detail, such as
`["Board", "records in git"]`.

lane.description:
The region whose band the item stays in, when it has no `region` of
its own; with a `region`, the two must name the same one.

radius.description: The mark's radius; 8 when left out.

region.description: The region the item belongs to; left out when it belongs to none.

side.description: The side of the mark the label sits on; right when left out.

ItemAnchor.description: A note's start, offset from an item's centre.

dx.description: How far right of the centre the text starts.

dy.description: How far below the centre the text's baseline sits.

Line.description:
A line from one item to another, drawn between the edges of their
marks.

from.description: The item the line starts at.

kind.description:
What the line means, such as `library` or `after`, which the page
gives a style of its own.

to.description: The item the line ends at.

LineAnchor.description:
A note's place on a line: a fraction of the way from `from` to `to`,
then `offset` units across the line, to the right of the line where
`offset` is positive.

along.description: How far along the line, from 0 at `from` to 1 at `to`.

offset.description: How far across the line; 9 when left out.

LineKind.description: How lines of one kind are drawn.

arrow.description: Whether the line ends in an arrow; true when left out.

kind.description: The kind, as a line's `kind` names it.

label.description: What the key says the line means, such as `builds after`.

style.description: How the stroke is drawn; solid when left out.

Note.description:
A short text that belongs to an item or to a line, placed from its
anchor's position whenever the map is drawn, so it moves with what it
describes.

Ramp.description: The shades of a map, from low to high, and what each stands for.

bins.description: What each bin stands for, lowest first, such as `none`, `1`, `2+`.

label.description: What the shade measures, such as `Open tasks`.

Region.description:
A titled rectangle that groups items. Its title sits in its top left
corner, and a label of an item in it must stay inside it.

id.description:
The region's name, unique among the map's regions, which an item's
`region` names.

title.description: The title drawn in the region's top left corner.

cells.description: The cells, one for each column.

item.description:
The item the row describes, which the page lights with the row;
left out when the row describes no item.

Sheet.description: The drawing area, from (0, 0) to (width, height).

Table.description: A table shown under the map.

caption.description: A sentence below the table; left out when it has none.

id.description: The table's name, unique among the map's tables.

rows.description: The rows, top to bottom; each has one cell for each column.

description:
`map/layout/v1` at `/maps/<name>`: one map's sheet, regions, items,
lines and notes, with each item's stored position and label side.

Positions and sizes are in layout units, one unit to a CSS pixel when
the page draws the sheet at its own size, with x to the right and y
down from the sheet's top left corner. An item with no `at` has no
stored position yet, so the map does not draw it.

accepts.description:
Findings the map's maker accepts, each with why, such as two lines
that must leave an item in one direction. `map.check` counts them
apart from its findings. Left out when the map accepts none.

items.description: What the map draws a mark and a label for.

line_kinds.description:
How the page draws each kind of line, with its entry in the key; a
kind with no entry is drawn solid, with an arrow, labelled by its
name. Left out when the map styles none.

lines.description: Lines between items; left out when the map has none.

notes.description:
Short texts placed beside an item or along a line; left out when the
map has none.

ramp.description:
The shades that an item's `bin` picks from, with what each stands
for; left out when no item is shaded.

regions.description:
Titled rectangles that group items, such as one per system or one
lane per stream of work; left out when the map has none.

sheet.description: The sheet every label must stay on.

tables.description:
Tables shown under the map, one after another; left out when the
map has none.

title.description: The map's title, such as `Services and their links`.

title: LayoutRecord
